data.name: Brenna
data.gender_notes: Brenna is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'brénein' meaning 'to burn'. This name was given to babies born with a fiery spirit or those who inspired passion in others. The name Brenna carries the meaning “Ardor, Passion” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Brenna usually hope their child will grow to embody ardor, passion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the burning love and passion for God and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Brenna belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ardor, Passion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Brenna total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: ברנה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ברנה הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו אולי ביוונית ברנה, שפירושו 'הבת של אלוהים' או 'הנזירה'. השם ברנה משמש גם כזכר וגם כנקבה, והוא נפוץ במספר תרבויות נוצריות.

in_greek.name: Βρέννα
in_greek.long_meaning: Βρέννα είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα που πιθανόν να προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'Βρене', που σημαίνει 'κόρη του Θεού' ή 'αφοσιωμένη στο Θεό'. Το όνομα Βρέννα χρησιμοποιείται και ως αρσενικό και ως θηλυκό και είναι δημοφιλές σε διάφορες χριστιανικές κουλτούρες.

in_latin.name: Brenna
in_latin.long_meaning: Brenna est nomen christianum quod fortasse originem ducit ex voce graeca 'Βρене', quae significat 'filius Dei' vel 'sanctimonia'. Nomen Brenna tam masculino quam feminino usurpari potest et in variis culturis christianis invenitur.

in_english.name: Brenna
in_english.meaning: a Christian name meaning 'little raven' or 'armored one'
in_english.long_meaning: Brenna is a Christian name with uncertain origins, possibly derived from the Celtic word for 'little raven' or the Greek term for 'armored one'. It signifies spiritual strength and vigilance. Historically used in various Christian cultures, Brenna symbolizes a strong connection to faith and divine protection.

data.cultural_impact: The name Brunna or Brenna, with its Greek origin and fiery meaning, has been popular in various cultures, not just within Christian communities. It has been used in literature and art, most famously in the character of Bérénice, a Carthaginian Queen in ancient Rome, who was known for her strong will and determination. This name resonated with those who sought inspiration and strength in the face of adversity and has been passed down through generations.
data.spiritual_significance: Brenna is the name of a child who embodies the spiritual qualities of passion, determination, and unwavering commitment. The name symbolizes the is a reminder of the fiery love that God has for us, and encourages us to live with the same passion and fire in our own lives. It also serves as a reminder to always hold on to our faith, no matter what challenges we may face. By bearing the name of Brenna, one is called to live a life filled with purpose, passion and unwavering commitment to their faith. May the fiery spirit of this name inspire and guide us through our spiritual journey.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Brenna: From the Old Irish word "bron," meaning sorrow, and "aine," meaning noble and high. A name for those bearing the cross of sorrow, embodying the noble and resilient spirit of Christ.

name_in_real_life.story: Grace Brenna, a minister in Jerusalem, Israel, shares that their name Brenna meaning "Ardor, Passion" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
